# Pull Request Template

## Description
Briefly describe what this PR changes and why.

## Related issue
- Closes #

## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation / CI / refactor

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the CONTRIBUTING guide
- [ ] I have run `ruff check .` and `ruff format .`
- [ ] I have run `pytest` and all tests pass
- [ ] I have added/updated tests for the change
- [ ] I have updated the README/docs where relevant
- [ ] My change does not introduce new secrets or credentials

## Screenshots / logs (if applicable)
